question: Which is the most available and most intensively used soil for agriculture in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alluvial soil**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Alluvial soil** is the most available and most intensively used soil for agriculture in India.
 
• It is predominantly found in the river basins, especially in the Indo-Gangetic plain, which covers the states of **Punjab, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, and West Bengal**.
